release_notes:
Updating from 1.2? Please install this update by hand, just this once.
Version 1.2 cannot start the installer: its Download and Install button closes the app without updating (and without saving your work).
Instead: save your work, close DALA·AEP SCP, then download DALA-AEP-SCP_Setup.exe from
https://github.com/roktemp29/dala-scp-releases/releases/tag/v1.3
and run it. Your projects and settings are kept. From 1.3 on, updates install from inside the app.

What's new in 1.3

- Dashboard: see your installed version, the latest release and its notes, and check for updates (Home > Dashboard, or Help > Dashboard).
- Scene detection shows a progress screen with real progress and a Cancel button. It is faster, keeps the final scene, and reuses saved results for files it has already analysed.
- Guided tour for new users, available any time from Help > Take the Guided Tour.
- Diagnostics (Help > Diagnostics) checks FFmpeg, folders, disk space and update access, and saves a report with personal details hidden.
- The app now checks for updates by itself once a day (you can turn this off), and installs them from inside the app.

Fixes
- Closing or removing a movie no longer mixes up the scenes, categories or exports of the other open movies.
- Exports never overwrite existing files, and Export All uses the folder you choose.
- Redo works, and category assignments can be undone.
- Projects restored from an auto-save now save back to your project file, and New and Open ask before discarding unsaved changes.
- Keyboard shortcuts no longer fire while you are typing or while a dialog is open.
